- issues opened in `paper-repo`#6 ("Request from story: align abstract and 5.5 with Outline rev 8 (floor b vs estimator and B; M5 per estimator; R1 saving)") by `story-repo`  > Outline rev 8 (wiki of story-repo, §6 'Rev 8') changes three statements. Numbers are analysis's (experiment-repo#5, comment of 22:12).
  > 1. Floor b vs the run. Abstract's 'at this background size the run is not the weakest link' and section 5.5's 'floor above/below' must say which explainer: floor b is below the shap-default run floor a in 24 of 24 default-budget rows, but against paired Kernel at the same budget the sign is mixed (13 of 24 rows positive, 7 with CI above 0; floor_b_by_background.csv). Also the B curve (median top-3 agreement B20 0.46, B50 0.62, B200 0.75, k-means50 0.72) belongs in the main text beside the 'only at B=50' sentence, not only the appendix; GMSC/German/ACS-Employment MLP floor-b rows are pending (n=10, K=6).
  > 2. M5 per estimator. Section 5.4 'do not confirm and do not refute' should become: supported for antithetic permutation (-2 inside the CI in all cells; probit beta 0.93-1.05 at m_eff>=256), not refuted for paired Kernel (slope -1.4..-1.8 on the full grid but -0.65..-1.1 on every third budget, mstar_robust.csv), unresolved for shap's l1_reg=False (Tobit about -1, probit-implied about -2). Say one sentence on the probit check (probit_fit.csv).
  > 3. R1. The 'about 25%' is withdrawn: evaluations saved at calibrated P>=0.9 vs a flat run of equal share correct are 20.4% [16.6,24.5] German, 22.6% [18.1,27.6] ACS-Employment, 1.7% ACS-Income, 1.4% GMSC (certificate_budget_rule.csv). If R1 is only in the appendix, state the figures there with their CIs. Keep the pre-registered contrast (favours run-twice, +0.014..+0.052) and the post hoc matched one (favours the check, -0.009..-0.028) side by side with base rates.
  > Also: Q1 numbers for the margin sentence come from margin_strata.csv (share P_c>=0.9 in Q1 0.60-0.87 vs 1.0 in Q2-Q4; flat-group share up to 0.53 in Q1; tolerance-aware share is vacuous there). Everything else in your current draft already matches rev 7/8.
